About Touch Stay
We're a cheery, optimistic team here at Touch Stay that believes in the human spirit and the power of communication. Find out more about us, our values and our people right here.
Why we launched Touch Stay?
Touch Stay digital guidebooks are the brainchild of Andy McNulty and Joe Jones – two serial travellers who kept on encountering the same issue over and over again: an absence of clear communication with their rental accommodation hosts.
After realising that they shared the same frustrations, they vowed to solve the problem together – and in 2014 Touch Stay was born.
Designed to help any type of hospitality professional better communicate with their guests, Touch Stay has gone on to become the highlight of guest reviews worldwide. It’s been cited as a reason for repeat bookings, longer stays and most importantly – happier guests.
Here to help you excel
Andy and Joe vowed to create a product that helps – a principle demonstrated by our close knit community and our user-focused approach to product development.
The aim was to create an easy-to-self-serve tool backed by a friendly, knowledgeable team should you need them.
Now an award winning SaaS company, Touch Stay is continuously working to create efficiencies for its users that enables them to focus on growing their businesses.
